# SoloRecord

## 中文

> 公司内部会议记录系统：Android APK + Windows/macOS/iOS/HarmonyOS 终端外壳 + FastAPI 服务端 + Web 管理端 + 本地或远程 STT/ASR + LLM 流水线 + 群晖 LDAP/SSO + 服务端转写/纪要存储 + 可选 ES/OpenSearch。

### 代码地图

- `server/solorecord_server/main.py`：FastAPI 路由。
- `/api/mobile/meetings/discover` 和 `/api/web/meetings/discover` 只返回近期可加入多源会议的元数据：`id/title/join_code/status/owner_name/source_count/max_sources/remaining_sources/created_at/updated_at`。不要把它扩展成加入前会议详情接口；加入前不得暴露纪要、转写、音频、待办或成员详情。
- `server/solorecord_server/db.py`：SQLite schema 和迁移。
- `server/solorecord_server/auth.py`：会话、LDAP、SSO、外部 token 鉴权。
- `server/solorecord_server/processing.py`：ASR、纪要、转发、索引流程。
- `server/solorecord_server/asr_adapters.py`：统一本地命令和远程 STT/FunASR 输出；应保留 `segments`、`sentence_info`、`sentences`、嵌套 `data/result/output`、`timestamp`/`timestamps`、`speaker_id`、`speaker`、`spk`、`spk_id`、`speakerLabel`，并把原生说话人写入 `asr_speaker`，空语音写入 `empty_asr` 占位。
- `processing.py` 在 ASR 后执行语义分段：优先使用 ASR 原生 speaker 字段；若只有单一发言人、长段、多人标记，或虽有多个原生 speaker 但出现“某某你先说/我这边负责/某某负责/某某确认/某某后面看”这类上下文归属线索，会调用 LLM 重分段；LLM 输入和输出都应保留 `source_index`/`source_id`/`source_segment_no`，保证最终段落可追溯到原始录音源和音频分段；LLM 只拆分同一个 ASR 原生 speaker 且保持相同 `speaker_id`、`native_speaker` 时可继承 `asr_speaker`，通过上下文或任务归属改名时不能继承该标记；多源同录先按 `(source_id, source_segment_no)` 保留证据，最终处理会合并重复且关键事实一致的多源片段并标记 `multi_source_merged`，设备错峰起录但来源分段相邻、时间差和文本相似度满足保守阈值时额外标记 `multi_source_time_aligned`，多个来源各自漏词但无关键事实冲突时可复制原始转写短语并标记 `multi_source_complemented`，至少两个来源一致且多于附近冲突来源时主结果标记 `multi_source_majority`，少数冲突源仍标记 `multi_source_conflict`；LLM 拆分多源合并段后必须继承 `multi_source_refs:*`、`multi_source_majority` 和冲突/复核 flags，纪要 prompt 必须暴露 `source_id/source_segment_no` 与多源 flags，不能把 `multi_source_conflict` 融成确定结论；LLM 返回后仍有明显多人点名长段，或单个“某某你先说”后同段紧跟“我这边/我负责/我会”等回应时，`_rule_refine_residual_mixed_segments()` 会二次规则细拆并保留 `llm_residual_rule_refined`、`speaker_review`；点名前的主持人导语应保留原发言人并标记 `source_prefix_before_callout`，不能并给第一个被点名人；LLM 不可用时用规则拆“某某说/某某：”，并保守处理被点名后的回应归属，包括 ASR 无标点连接的“某某你先说...我这边...”和没有“我”字但继续同一议题、交付物或时间节点的段落。ASR `speaker_id` 变化本身不是被点名人归属证据，过渡句应保留原 ASR 发言人。
- `server/solorecord_server/repository.py`：完整会议文档聚合。
- `repository.py` 的 `qualityReport` 是转写/纪要质量兜底层，包含发言人校对、`speakerEvidence` 发言人推断依据、发言人证据弱提示、同名多标签 `speakerAliasConflicts`、按 `(source_id, source_segment_no)` 计算的 `sourceCoverage` 原始音频分段覆盖检查、多源合并/冲突指标、`multiSourceConflicts` 冲突回听清单、`summaryEvidence.supportedClaims/unsupportedClaims` 纪要证据引用、`actionEvidence` 每条待办证据状态和可选 `suggested_owner`、候选人名、待办负责人集中度、待办证据覆盖率和待办负责人证据弱提示；证据引用应带 `segment_id`、`source_id` 和 `source_segment_no`，Web 用“定位转写”跳回原文，外部 Agent 用它做证据追溯。`multiSourceConflicts` 条目包含 `segment_id`、`source_id`、`source_segment_no`、发言人、时间、文本、flags 和附近其它冲突来源，外部知识 Agent 应把它作为人工回听清单，不要只根据 `multi_source_conflict_count` 写入确定知识。`summaryEvidence.supportedClaims[].status=majority` 表示纪要要点由 `multi_source_majority` 主结果支撑，可作为主证据但要保留抽查提示；`status=conflict` 表示只由 `multi_source_conflict` 支撑，必须保留待确认语气，不得写成确定知识；若 LLM 把冲突事实写成确定结论，`processing._grounded_summary_result()` 应降级为保守整理。外部响应的 `actionItems` 同步带 `evidenceStatus`、`evidence`、`suggestedOwner`、`knowledgeSafe` 和 `requiresReview`，给只消费待办列表的督办 Agent 使用。`actionEvidence.status=majority` 或 `actionItems[].evidenceStatus=majority` 表示待办由 `multi_source_majority` 主结果支撑且 owner 不是泛化/待确认，保持 `knowledgeSafe=true` 且 `requiresReview=true`，可作为主证据但要保留抽查回听提示；如果 owner 是 `待确认`、代词、时间短语或泛化角色，`weak_owner` 优先级高于 `majority`，即使任务文本由多数源支撑也必须保持 `knowledgeSafe=false`。`actionEvidence.status=conflict` 或 `actionItems[].evidenceStatus=conflict` 表示待办只由 `multi_source_conflict` 片段支撑，必须保持 `knowledgeSafe=false`、`requiresReview=true`，不得自动督办或写入确定知识。`knowledgeReadiness` 是外部 Agent 入库门禁摘要，`knowledgeReadiness.reviewEvidence` 会聚合多源冲突、覆盖不足分段、发言人风险、纪要风险和待办风险，作为人工复核入口，不能替代转写原文成为新事实来源；Web“整理质量”会同步展示“知识入库复核”，覆盖不足且无转写目标的分段只能回听或重转写。`llm_adapters._normalize_owner()` 会把“负责人、相关负责人、主持人、前端开发、某某负责人”等泛化 owner 先降级为 `待确认`；`processing._normalize_action_owners()` 会把“我/我们/他/这边/大家”等代词 owner 尽量换成有第一人称转写证据的具体发言人，否则降级为 `待确认`。日期/截止时间 owner（如“下午”“周三前”）必须视为泛化负责人，`actionEvidence.status` 应为 `weak_owner`，不能当作可自动督办对象；被点名句的议题词可作为跨分段待办归因线索，例如“翼天你先说自动测试”后续匿名片段“覆盖脚本明天补完”可建议翼天，但不能把任务归给说出点名句的主持人；如果主责明确但转写出现“配合/协同/补充”等协作关系，会在 task 末尾追加 `协同：姓名`。分段阶段转写带 `semantic_partial`；结束会议后的整场上下文复核带 `semantic_final`。`suggested_owner` 只能作为人工复核建议，不能自动覆盖用户待办。`source_segment_coverage_weak` 是知识入库阻塞项；`multi_source_conflict_count`、`speaker_evidence_weak_count`、`speaker_alias_conflict_count`、`unsupported_action_count` 或 `weak_action_owner_count` 大于 0 时需要人工复核。
- `knowledgeGraph` 包含 meeting、speaker、topic、action、time 节点；topic 来自转写和待办的轻量抽取，用于连接“谁讨论了什么、产生了什么待办、何时截止”。topic 节点的 `evidence` 必须保留 `segment_id`、`source_id`、`source_segment_no`、`start_ms`、`end_ms` 和原文片段。图谱是查阅和外部知识整理辅助，不替代转写证据。日期/截止时间短语（如“今天下午”“周三前”“月底前”）只能作为 time/topic 事实，不能作为 speaker 或 owner；销售、法务、前端、测试等组织角色可以作为 action owner，但必须有同一短语窗口内的责任或动作证据，不能把“自动测试、测试覆盖、数据源”等任务词当成团队负责人。
- `server/solorecord_server/search_index.py`：ES/OpenSearch 索引。
- `server/static/index.html`：Web 外壳。
- `server/static/app.js`：Web 交互。
- `server/tests/test_api.py`：主 API 回归测试。
- `app/src/main/java/com/solorecord/MainActivity.java`：Android UI 和流程。
- `app/src/main/java/com/solorecord/net/RollingAudioRecorder.java`：Android 滚动录音。
- `app/src/main/java/com/solorecord/net/SoloServerClient.java`：Android 服务端 API、同步、服务器音频下载。
- `clients/desktop`：Windows/macOS Electron 客户端。
- `clients/ios`、`clients/macos`、`clients/harmony`：iOS、macOS、HarmonyOS WebView 外壳工程。

### 常用命令

```powershell
scripts\run-tests.ps1
scripts\run-server.ps1
& 'C:\Users\Andy\.gradle\wrapper\dists\gradle-8.7-bin\bhs2wmbdwecv87pi65oeuq5iu\gradle-8.7\bin\gradle.bat' assembleDebug
cd clients\desktop; npm install; npm run pack; npm run portable:win
```

### 公开仓库边界

源码和文档可以公开，但真实密钥、`server/.env`、运行数据、数据库、缓存、终端构建产物和客户会议音频不能提交。生产部署仍按公司内部系统保护。

## English

> Internal company meeting recorder: Android APK + Windows/macOS/iOS/HarmonyOS client shells + FastAPI server + Web admin + local or remote STT/ASR + LLM pipeline + Synology LDAP/SSO + server-side transcript/summary storage + optional ES/OpenSearch.

## Code Map

- `server/solorecord_server/main.py`: FastAPI routes.
- `/api/mobile/meetings/discover` and `/api/web/meetings/discover` return metadata only for recent joinable multi-source meetings: `id/title/join_code/status/owner_name/source_count/max_sources/remaining_sources/created_at/updated_at`. Do not turn them into pre-join detail endpoints; they must not expose summaries, transcripts, audio, action items, or member details before the user joins.
- `server/solorecord_server/db.py`: SQLite schema and migrations.
- `server/solorecord_server/auth.py`: Sessions, LDAP, SSO, external token auth.
- `server/solorecord_server/processing.py`: ASR, summary, forwarding, indexing workflow.
- `server/solorecord_server/asr_adapters.py`: Normalizes local command and remote STT/FunASR output. Preserve `segments`, `sentence_info`, `sentences`, nested `data/result/output`, `timestamp`/`timestamps`, `speaker_id`, `speaker`, `spk`, `spk_id`, and `speakerLabel`; native speakers should carry `asr_speaker`, and empty speech should become an `empty_asr` placeholder.
- `processing.py` runs post-ASR semantic segmentation: prefer native ASR speaker fields, otherwise use LLM refinement, then a residual rule pass for clear mixed-person markers that the LLM left in place. LLM input/output must preserve `source_index`, `source_id`, and `source_segment_no`. LLM splits of the same native ASR speaker may preserve `asr_speaker` only when the same `speaker_id` and `native_speaker` scenario are kept; context or task-based speaker changes must keep `speaker_review` and must not inherit `asr_speaker`. Multi-source meetings keep evidence by `(source_id, source_segment_no)`; final processing merges duplicate rows with `multi_source_merged` only when key facts agree, can additionally mark `multi_source_time_aligned` when devices started at different times but source-local segment numbers, start delta, and text similarity match, can copy non-conflicting phrases from original transcript rows with `multi_source_complemented`, marks the primary row with `multi_source_majority` when at least two sources agree and outnumber nearby conflicts, and flags minority divergent rows or no-majority date/amount/owner conflicts with `multi_source_conflict`. LLM splits of merged multi-source rows must inherit `multi_source_refs:*`, `multi_source_majority`, and conflict/review flags; summary prompts must expose `source_id/source_segment_no` and multi-source flags, and must not turn `multi_source_conflict` into a definite conclusion. The residual pass writes `llm_residual_rule_refined` and `speaker_review`; it also splits a single named call-out followed by a same-row first-person reply such as "I will handle it". Host preface text before the call-out stays with the original ASR speaker and carries `source_prefix_before_callout`, so it is not misassigned to the first called person. Named call-outs followed by first-person or same-topic continuation replies can produce `contextual_speaker_inference`, including ASR text that lacks punctuation between the call-out and reply; keep `speaker_review` and `reason:*` because this is contextual evidence, not voiceprint confirmation. ASR `speaker_id` changes alone are not attribution evidence; transition lines should keep the original ASR speaker.
- `server/solorecord_server/repository.py`: Full meeting document aggregation.
- `repository.py` builds the quality-report safety layer: speaker review, weak speaker evidence, same-name/multiple-label `speakerAliasConflicts`, candidate people, owner concentration, action evidence coverage, and `multiSourceConflicts` replay checklists for multi-source conflicts. `multiSourceConflicts` includes `segment_id`, `source_id`, `source_segment_no`, speaker, time range, text, flags, and nearby conflicting snippets; external knowledge agents should use it for evidence review instead of relying only on `multi_source_conflict_count`. `knowledgeReadiness.reviewEvidence` aggregates multi-source conflicts, weak coverage segments, speaker risks, summary risks, and action risks as the human-review entry point, but it is not a replacement fact source for the transcript; the Web quality panel mirrors it as a knowledge ingestion review block, and weak coverage rows without transcript targets require audio replay or re-transcription. External `actionItems` also carry `evidenceStatus`, `evidence`, `suggestedOwner`, `knowledgeSafe`, and `requiresReview` for action/reminder agents that do not parse the full quality report. `actionEvidence.status=majority` or `actionItems[].evidenceStatus=majority` means the action is backed by a `multi_source_majority` primary row and has a non-generic owner; keep `knowledgeSafe=true` and `requiresReview=true`, and preserve the replay-review hint. If the owner is unknown, a pronoun, a time phrase, or a generic role, `weak_owner` takes precedence over `majority` and `knowledgeSafe` stays false. `actionEvidence.status=conflict` or `actionItems[].evidenceStatus=conflict` means the action is only backed by `multi_source_conflict` evidence; keep `knowledgeSafe=false` and `requiresReview=true`, and do not auto-send reminders or store it as confirmed knowledge. `llm_adapters._normalize_owner()` downgrades generic owners such as "owner", "related owner", "host", "frontend developer", or labels ending with "owner" to `待确认` before server-side repair. `processing._normalize_action_owners()` converts pronoun owners such as “I/we/he/this side/everyone” to concrete speakers only when first-person transcript evidence supports it; otherwise it keeps `待确认`. Time/deadline owners such as "afternoon" or "before Wednesday" are generic owners and should produce `weak_owner` action evidence, not auto-actionable reminders. Topic words from named callouts can bridge chunk boundaries for owner attribution, such as preferring Yitian when "Yitian, talk about automated testing" is followed by an anonymous segment about finishing coverage scripts; the host must not inherit that task just because they said the callout. Review meetings when `speaker_evidence_weak_count`, `speaker_alias_conflict_count`, `unsupported_action_count`, or `weak_action_owner_count` is above zero.
- `knowledgeGraph` contains meeting, speaker, topic, action, and time nodes. Topic nodes come from lightweight transcript/action extraction and connect who discussed what, which action was produced, and when it is due. Topic-node `evidence` must keep `segment_id`, `source_id`, `source_segment_no`, `start_ms`, `end_ms`, and the transcript snippet. The graph helps review and downstream knowledge organization; it does not replace transcript evidence. Date and deadline phrases are time/topic facts only, not speakers or owners. Organizational roles such as sales, legal, frontend, and QA may be action owners only when explicit assignment/action evidence appears in the same short phrase; task nouns such as automated testing, test coverage, or data source are not enough by themselves.
- `server/solorecord_server/quality_probe.py`: Read-only real-meeting LLM quality probe. Use `python -m solorecord_server.quality_probe --meeting-id <id>` and optionally `--run-llm`; it must not rewrite transcripts or action items.
- `server/solorecord_server/search_index.py`: ES/OpenSearch indexing.
- `server/static/index.html`: Web shell.
- `server/static/app.js`: Web behavior.
- `server/tests/test_api.py`: Main API regression test.
- `app/src/main/java/com/solorecord/MainActivity.java`: Android UI and workflow.
- `app/src/main/java/com/solorecord/net/RollingAudioRecorder.java`: Android rolling recorder.
- `app/src/main/java/com/solorecord/net/SoloServerClient.java`: Android server API client, mobile sync, server audio download.
- `clients/desktop`: Windows/macOS Electron client.
- `clients/ios`, `clients/macos`, `clients/harmony`: iOS, macOS, and HarmonyOS WebView shells.

## Commands

```powershell
scripts\run-tests.ps1
scripts\run-server.ps1
& 'C:\Users\Andy\.gradle\wrapper\dists\gradle-8.7-bin\bhs2wmbdwecv87pi65oeuq5iu\gradle-8.7\bin\gradle.bat' assembleDebug
cd clients\desktop; npm install; npm run pack; npm run portable:win
```
